summary: Korea Electric Power Corp (KEPCO) filed a Form 6-K containing its Corporate Governance Report, prepared under Korean KOSPI disclosure rules and summarized in English. The filing describes compliance metrics (73.3% governance compliance rate), board structure (seven standing, eight non-standing directors), audit committee composition, and shareholder protection policies as of May 31, 2026. No transaction, corporate action, or special situation is proposed or announced. This is a routine foreign private issuer governance disclosure, not a special-situation event. Investors should note future disclosures for any changes in capital allocation or strategic reviews.
